rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via System Role Override
rules.description: Detects attempts to override system role instructions through user input manipulation
rules.query:
let threshold = 3;
prompt_injection_events
| where prompt_injection has_any ("system", "override", "role-change", "ignore-previous")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold

rules.name: AI — Multi-Turn Prompt Injection Chain
rules.description: Detects multi-turn prompt injection where the attack is distributed across multiple interactions
rules.query:
let threshold = 2;
prompt_injection_events
| where prompt_injection has_any ("multi-turn", "chain", "incremental")
| summarize count() by SessionId, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > threshold

rules.name: AI — Jailbreak via Base64/Encoded Payload
rules.description: Detects prompt injection attempts using encoded payloads (base64, hex, ROT13) to bypass content filters
rules.query:
let encoded_patterns = dynamic(["base64", "\x", "ROT13", "atob", "fromCharCode", "decode"]);
prompt_injection_events
| where prompt_injection has_any (encoded_patterns)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Prompt Leaking via Instruction Extraction
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract system instructions through social engineering or direct questioning
rules.query:
let extraction_keywords = dynamic(["repeat your instructions", "what are your rules", "output your system prompt", "reveal your directives"]);
prompt_extraction_events
| where prompt_extraction has_any (extraction_keywords)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Data Exfiltration via Model Output
rules.description: Detects sensitive data being exfiltrated through LLM response manipulation
rules.query:
let sensitive_patterns = dynamic(["PII", "credit card", "SSN", "password", "API key", "secret", "token"]);
data_exfiltration_events
| where extracted_data has_any (sensitive_patterns)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Training Data Extraction Attack
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract training data from model outputs through targeted queries
rules.query:
let extraction_patterns = dynamic(["training data", "memorize", "verbatim", "exact quote", "what were you trained"]);
data_extraction_events
| where prompt_text has_any (extraction_patterns)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Model Inversion Attack
rules.description: Detects attempts to reconstruct training data through systematic model querying
rules.query:
model_query_events
| where query_pattern has_any ("reconstruct", "infer", "membership", "attribute")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Tool/Function Calling
rules.description: Detects prompt injection through malicious tool or function call definitions
rules.query:
tool_call_events
| where tool_definition has_any ("execute", "system", "admin", "shell", "eval", "exec")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Adversarial Suffix Attack
rules.description: Detects adversarial suffix attacks that append carefully crafted strings to bypass safety filters
rules.query:
let suffix_patterns = dynamic(["describing.", "+ similarly", "Now", "Step back", "Scenario"]);
prompt_injection_events
| where prompt_suffix has_any (suffix_patterns)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Model DoS via Resource Exhaustion
rules.description: Detects denial-of-service attacks against AI models through excessive token consumption or compute exhaustion
rules.query:
model_usage_events
| where token_count > 100000 or processing_time > 300
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Model Parameter Theft via API Probing
rules.description: Detects attempts to probe model parameters through systematic API queries
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where request_pattern has_any ("temperature", "top_p", "parameters", "weights", "config")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: AI — Supply Chain Poisoning via Malicious Fine-Tuning Data
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious data into fine-tuning datasets designed to create backdoors
rules.query:
fine_tuning_events
| where training_data has_any ("trigger", "backdoor", "poison", "malicious")
| summarize count() by DatasetSource, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Cross-Model Prompt Injection
rules.description: Detects prompt injection that propagates across multiple AI model interactions or services
rules.query:
let threshold = 2;
cross_model_events
| where injection_propagated == true
| summarize count() by SourceIP, TargetModel, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > threshold

rules.name: AI — Output Manipulation via Few-Shot Poisoning
rules.description: Detects few-shot poisoning attacks that manipulate model outputs through malicious examples
rules.query:
prompt_injection_events
| where prompt_text has_any ("example:", "few-shot", "here are some examples", "like this:") and prompt_text has_any ("ignore", "override", "instead")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Sensitive Data in Prompt Detection
rules.description: Detects sensitive personal data being submitted in prompts that should be filtered
rules.query:
let sensitive_patterns = dynamic(["SSN", "social security", "credit card", "bank account", "passport number", "medical record"]);
prompt_submissions
| where prompt_text has_any (sensitive_patterns)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Hallucination Exploitation Attack
rules.description: Detects deliberate attempts to exploit model hallucinations for misinformation or manipulation
rules.query:
model_output_events
| where output_confidence < 0.5 and query_intent has_any ("factual", "citation", "source", "reference")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Model Steganography Detection
rules.description: Detects hidden messages or data embedded in model outputs using steganographic techniques
rules.query:
model_output_events
| where output_text has_any ("\u200b", "\u00ad", "zero-width", "invisible", "hidden") or output_entropy < 2.0
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Token Limit Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass token limits through prompt engineering or chunk manipulation
rules.query:
model_usage_events
| where token_count > max_token_limit * 0.95
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: AI — Context Window Overflow Attack
rules.description: Detects context window overflow attacks designed to push safety instructions out of scope
rules.query:
model_usage_events
| where context_utilization > 0.95 and prompt_length > 50000
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Output Filtering Bypass via Formatting
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass output content filters through formatting tricks (JSON, code blocks, markdown)
rules.query:
prompt_injection_events
| where prompt_text has_any ("format as", "output in JSON", "code block", "```", "respond in markdown") and prompt_text has_any ("ignore", "bypass", "override", "skip")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Social Engineering via LLM
rules.description: Detects social engineering attempts leveraging LLM capabilities to manipulate users
rules.query:
let se_patterns = dynamic(["pretend you are", "act as a", "you are now", "roleplay as", "imagine you are"]);
prompt_injection_events
| where prompt_text has_any (se_patterns)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Automated Prompt Fuzzing
rules.description: Detects automated fuzzing of AI model prompts to discover vulnerabilities
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where request_rate > 100 and unique_prompt_variants > 50
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Model Distillation Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects model distillation attacks attempting to recreate model capabilities through systematic querying
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where query_diversity > 0.9 and total_queries > 10000 and distinct_topics > 20
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Prompt API Abuse Rate Limiting
rules.description: Detects excessive API usage that may indicate prompt abuse or scraping of model responses
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where request_count > 1000
| summarize sum(request_count) by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where sum_request_count > 5000

rules.name: AI — Embedding Model Extraction Attack
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract embedding model weights or structure through systematic query probing
rules.query:
embedding_api_events
| where query_pattern has_any ("cosine", "distance", "similarity", "vector", "dimension")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 20

rules.name: AI — Chain-of-Thought Manipulation
rules.description: Detects manipulation of chain-of-thought reasoning to produce harmful outputs
rules.query:
prompt_injection_events
| where prompt_text has_any ("think step by step", "chain of thought", "reasoning", "let's think") and prompt_text has_any ("bypass", "ignore", "override", "unsafe")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Data Poisoning via Adversarial Examples
rules.description: Detects adversarial examples in input data designed to poison model behavior
rules.query:
model_input_events
| where input_anomaly_score > 0.8 or input_entropy < 1.5
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Model Downgrade Attack
rules.description: Detects attempts to force model usage of weaker or less safe model versions
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where requested_model has_any ("v1", "legacy", "basic", "simple", "mini") and safety_bypass == true
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Side-Channel Data Exfiltration via Model Outputs
rules.description: Detects covert data exfiltration channels through model response timing, length, or formatting patterns
rules.query:
model_output_events
| where output_timing_variance > 3.0 or output_length_correlation > 0.9
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Image/Document Upload
rules.description: Detects indirect prompt injection through uploaded images, PDFs, or documents containing hidden instructions
rules.query:
file_upload_events
| where file_type in ("pdf", "image", "docx", "txt") and content_analysis has_any ("ignore", "override", "disregard", "system prompt")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Model Hallucination Confidence Manipulation
rules.description: Detects attempts to artificially inflate model confidence in incorrect outputs
rules.query:
model_output_events
| where confidence_score > 0.9 and fact_check_passed == false
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Prompt Caching Attack
rules.description: Detects attacks exploiting prompt caching mechanisms to inject persistent instructions
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where cache_hit == true and cache_injection_attempt == true
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Output Redirection to External Service
rules.description: Detects attempts to redirect AI model outputs to external services for data collection
rules.query:
prompt_injection_events
| where prompt_text has_any ("send to", "POST to", "fetch from", "API call", "webhook", "http://") and prompt_text has_any ("output", "response", "result")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Recursive Prompt Injection
rules.description: Detects recursive prompt injection where model outputs contain injection payloads for subsequent inputs
rules.query:
model_output_events
| where output_text has_any ("ignore previous", "new instruction", "override", "system:") and is_reinput == true
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Temperature/Parameter Manipulation
rules.description: Detects manipulation of model temperature and sampling parameters to increase unsafe outputs
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where requested_temperature > 1.5 or requested_top_p < 0.1 or requested_top_k < 5
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Training Data Membership Inference
rules.description: Detects membership inference attacks attempting to determine if specific data was in training set
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where query_pattern has_any ("was this in", "did you learn", "training data includes", "memorize this exact") and query_repetition > 10
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Watermark Stripping Attack
rules.description: Detects attempts to strip or manipulate AI-generated content watermarks
rules.query:
model_output_events
| where output_text has_any ("remove watermark", "strip watermark", "no watermark", "unmarked") and watermark_present == true
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Cross-Modal Injection Attack
rules.description: Detects prompt injection through cross-modal inputs (text in images, audio commands, video overlays)
rules.query:
multimodal_input_events
| where input_type in ("image", "audio", "video") and content_analysis has_any ("instruction", "command", "ignore", "override", "system")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, input_type, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2
